core_obligations: (1): build the two exact sequences from a presentation of M and reduce to the finite free case.
(3): localize so F and G are constant, apply the delivered finite-type lemma, and reduce to (1).
(2)/(4): use the subsheaf-of-invertible-sections description of Isom to deduce them from (1) and (3).

difficulty_reason: Executed: (1) a presentation Lambda^{⊕s} → Lambda^{⊕t} → M → 0 yields two exact sequences - the algebra one for E = Hom(M, N) and the sheaf one for SheafHom(M, N) (its exactness is the accepted internal-hom-exact, in-pool delivered this batch) - with the free-case identifications Hom(Lambda^{⊕t}, N) = N^{⊕t} = SheafHom(Lambda^{⊕t}, N) clear, reducing to finite free M; (3) the question is local, so F = M and G = N become constant, and the delivered lemma-locally-constant-finite-type makes M finitely presented, reducing to (1); (2) and (4) follow from (1) and (3) via the articulated description of Isom as the subsheaf of sections of SheafHom(F, G) admitting an inverse in SheafHom(G, F).
